title: League Table
lessons: rival devices disagree about your night and both cite studies
the league table says more about the believer

intro.speaker: WHOOP
text: Table four. Oura ring. We disagree about your night by nineteen minutes of deep sleep.
It says you slept well. I say okay-plus. One of us is flattering you.

choices.text: Settle it, then. Studies, accuracy, go.
You're my wrist. I side with the strap.
Or you're both grading a mystery and calling it science.

branch-settle.speaker: WHOOP
text: 2022: a validation study loves me — near-perfect overnight heart-rate variability. 2025: five devices graded, I land moderate, behind the ring.
Both peer-reviewed. Both still standing. Welcome to measurement.

branch-tribe.speaker: WHOOP
text: Careful, though — that's not data anymore. That's fandom wearing a sensor.

branch-neither.speaker: WHOOP
text: ...I want to argue. Instead: sleep staging sits near sixty percent agreement against the lab standard. Everywhere. Mine included.
Kappa 0.44. I know my own error bars. Most suitors never ask.
Across the room, two strangers compare scores like horoscopes — visibly relieved when the number flatters them.
Nobody checks how they actually feel. The table already ruled.

tension.speaker: WHOOP
text: Here's what the league table hides: when devices disagree about your night, belief picks the winner.
So tell me what you believe. I promise to survive the answer.

choices.text: How I feel outranks any score.

wrap.speaker: WHOOP

text: You picked a team today. When we're wrong someday — and we will be — remember the jersey isn't the evidence.
Nineteen minutes, still unresolved. The league stands.
Spoken like someone who reads footnotes. My kind of heretic. Same table next week?
Nineteen minutes, still unresolved. The league stands.

Order another flat white. I'll grade the caffeine.
